svg.title: White/Black Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive vector after actual visual inspection. Approximate contours and vivid screen colors. Shaped parallelogram support with a white curved field and black upper-right wedge. Gray surrounding photo background is wall, not a painted rectangular ground. Painted white is retained.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.artic.edu/artworks/66184; inspected 2026-10-27; interpretive study, not a facsimile.
